text: Pinned-source audit corrects the current-reference assumption: both fast cosine and generic controls in the baseline pin sample the candidate multiset first and remove only the first true-match occurrence; repeated true matches can survive. Native relations will continue excluding all same-match candidates before keyed BottomK. The fixture records the R multiset, draws, realized n_perm and analytic means; no PRNG or denominator equivalence is claimed. Exact microsecond replication deliberately differs from R floating truncation at duration 0.29 seconds / period 0.01 seconds.
